test_command: mkdir -p /workspace/test-results && cd /workspace/repo && rm -rf build && sed -i '/add_library(maeparser/a target_compile_options(maeparser PRIVATE -Wnon-virtual-dtor -Werror=non-virtual-dtor)' CMakeLists.txt && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DBUILD_TESTING=ON && make -j$(nproc) && ctest --output-on-failure --output-junit /workspace/test-results/output.xml
